subject: POC kickoff & load testing session — GreenGrid Analytics
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Martinez <sofiam@greengrid.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@greengrid.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: POC kickoff & load testing session — GreenGrid Analytics

Hi Sofia / Tom,

Thanks again for the time in last week's discovery call — excited to kick off the POC. We'd like to get a 90-minute kickoff + hands-on working session scheduled so we can:
- Review prompt sets and expected routing behaviors
- Walk through the test harness and measurement plan
- Run initial load tests to validate throughput targets and latency SLOs

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue Mar 3 — 10:00–11:30am PT
- Thu Mar 5 — 9:00–10:30am PT
- Fri Mar 6 — 1:00–2:30pm PT

Attached: POC agenda (PDF) and initial load-test plan (XLSX). Can you confirm who from your team will attend and which slot works best? Also if you have an internal test harness we should integrate with, please share a link.

Attendees from our side: me (AE), Logan (SE), Dev (CS engineer).

Goal for the session: run a light benchmark that gets us data to iterate on batch sizes and routing rules, and to agree on throughput targets (requests/sec or tokens/sec) and p95/p99 latency SLOs.

Thanks — Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0172
From: Sofia Martinez <sofiam@greengrid.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@greengrid.com>, David Li <david.li@greengrid.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 11:03:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff & load testing session — GreenGrid Analytics

Hi Marissa — thanks for the agenda and the attachments. We're excited to get started.

A couple notes on availability: our engineering lead David Li is on travel the week of Mar 2–6 and won't be available on Mar 3. We can do a kickoff/demo with product + ops this week and schedule the hands-on load test the following week when David is back. If you prefer to combine, our earliest full-team slot is Thu Mar 12 in the afternoon PT.

If you need to keep it earlier, Tom and I can meet with your team on Thu Mar 5 at 9am PT for the walkthrough; we would then schedule a separate hands-on load test with David.

Also: we use an internal k6-based harness and can share the repo — I can pull the link once I'm back at my desk. For the initial benchmark, our target is roughly 250 req/s with p95 < 200ms for the trimmed prompt set. Will that give you the data you need to recommend batching/quantization approaches?

Best,
Sofia

Sofia Martinez
Director of Product | GreenGrid Analytics
sofiam@greengrid.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Martinez <sofiam@greengrid.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@greengrid.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC kickoff & load testing session — GreenGrid Analytics

Hi Sofia — appreciate the detail. Either approach works for us; separating the kickoff and the hands-on load test is fine and might even be preferable. That said, if Tom and you can do the walkthrough on Thu Mar 5 9am PT, we can use that session to confirm the prompt routing and run a short warm-up benchmark. Then schedule the full load run the week of Mar 9 when David is available.

Quick proposals:
- Thu Mar 5, 9:00–10:30am PT: kickoff + walkthrough + 15–20 min warm-up run (light load)
- Tue Mar 10, 10:00–11:30am PT: dedicated load testing session (full run, orange/green rollout testing)

Pre-ask for the hands-on load test:
- Confirm throughput target (you mentioned ~250 req/s) and whether that's steady-state or peak burst;
- Confirm sequence length assumptions (avg tokens/input, max tokens);
- Any authentication/network constraints for us connecting to your harness (VPC peering, SSH jumpbox, public endpoints);
- Attach any k6 scripts or a repo link — we'll mirror and run from our test runners as needed.

Logan and Dev — tagging you to confirm availability for these slots.

Thanks — Marissa
From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@greengrid.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Sofia Martinez <sofiam@greengrid.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 13:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC kickoff & load testing session — GreenGrid Analytics

Marissa/Sofia — Thu Mar 5 9am PT works for us for the walkthrough. We'll plan the full load test for the week of Mar 9 — Tue Mar 10 at 10am PT looks good on our side.

Attendees from GreenGrid for the walkthrough: Sofia Martinez (Product), Tom Reynolds (Ops). For the load test: add David Li (Engineering).

To clarify targets: the 250 req/s I mentioned is a sustained target for the use case we're simulating (short prompts, ~120 tokens/request). Peak may be up to ~350 req/s for short bursts. Our p95 target is <= 200ms; p99 ideally under 400ms. We'll send the k6 repo link by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks — Tom
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Martinez <sofiam@greengrid.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@greengrid.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Mar 2026 12:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC kickoff & load testing session — GreenGrid Analytics

Thanks all — I've sent calendar invites for:
- Thu Mar 5, 9:00–10:30am PT — POC kickoff & walkthrough (invite attached)
- Tue Mar 10, 10:00–11:30am PT — Load test session (placeholder invite)

Pre-reads and links:
- Initial load-test plan (attached)
- Test harness repo (Redwood): https://github.com/redwood-inference/poc-load-harness
- Shared folder with prompt sets and sample payloads: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1XYZ-poc-prep

Notes on the initial run (to align expectations):
- We'll validate both requests/sec and tokens/sec measurements; please confirm average tokens/request (Tom suggested ~120).
- We'll run a stepped test: 50 -> 125 -> 250 -> 350 req/s with 5-minute holds, and collect p50/p95/p99 latencies and error rates.
- Goal is to identify batching and prefix-cache opportunities; we will not change model config mid-run unless we agree to a controlled orange/green switch.

Logan / Dev — heads up, GreenGrid will share their k6 scripts. If we need to run from their harness, we'll coordinate networking details (likely use a public endpoint + auth token for the initial run; for full ramp we may use a peered runner).

Attachments: 20260220-poc-agenda.pdf, 20260220-load-test-plan.xlsx

Cheers,
Marissa
